target.interpretation: Containing native grid cell; not a point measurement or a mission landing footprint.

limitations: Tolerances, area ratio and minimum fit are uncalibrated engineering defaults.
Native grid cells have approximately comparable but unequal physical support.
Fit is not a probability, accuracy estimate or hardware-performance prediction.
Selection resolves to an entire native cell. Small clicks across a cell boundary can change the compared region and ranking sharply; always display its footprint.
Environmental thresholds are experimental screening choices; no success probability is estimated.
Land cover and aridity are Earth-only filters from different historical periods, not additional similarity terms.
Seasonal greenness, actual access, exposed mineralogy, boulders and mechanical strength remain unverified.
NDVI scale is provisional; NDVI does not affect eligibility or rank.
